pages.title: A camera turns the wall into a touch screen
bullets: A projector shows the interface on the board
A fixed camera watches the board
The red dot of the pointer is the cursor
The remote buttons are the mouse clicks

pages.title: The processing pipeline
pages.caption: Camera frame -> dot -> board coordinates -> click -> interface

pages.title: Image coordinates -> board coordinates
bullets: The board is a plane: a 3x3 homography maps pixels to board points
4 calibration targets give 8 equations: solved with the DLT
Validation points measure the error in pixels
